cases.target: A repo opts into the push gate with a tracked .own-your-diff marker. quizgate install writes the pre-push hook into the clone's own hooks directory instead of pointing core.hooksPath at a tracked .githooks dir, and quizgate sync keeps a copy of quizgate on PATH and installs the hook in opted-in clones that lack it.
incidental: the selftest file moving to the repo root
the wording edits in SKILL.md and agent-mode.md

cases.head: a5f4dbc
cases.target: The skill ships as one plugin tree that Claude Code, Factory Droid, and Codex all read: a session-start hook runs quizgate sync, a PreToolUse guard denies an agent's git push --no-verify and core.hooksPath changes, and an installer adds the plugin to every harness on PATH and trusts the Codex hooks.
incidental: the exact JSON-RPC calls of codex-trust-hooks

cases.head: a2e3f05
cases.target: A clone whose core.hooksPath names a directory that no longer exists gets it unset at session start, so the hook is installed again. When core.hooksPath names a real directory, such as husky's, install writes nothing there and prints the line to add.

cases.head: 906a0bd
cases.target: Bump the plugin version to 0.2.0 in both manifests.

cases.head: 0fbb0cf
cases.target: Add a README and AGENTS.md that explain install, opt-in, and updates.

cases.head: 79d8fea
cases.target: The text stream holds back the last (longest secret - 1) characters across the whole assistant message, so a secret split across text deltas or text blocks never reaches a listener whole. It flushes at message_end and never cuts a surrogate pair.

cases.head: 883542f
cases.target: check(run) judges a run from its log alone: five engine invariants that every trial must keep, where one failure is a bug, and nine model behaviors measured as rates that skip when their precondition never happened. Cost is reported and never judged.
incidental: the TypeScript types of the case tables

cases.head: 68ee990
cases.target: Scenarios become data files run by one runner that writes each run as a result directory, a check(run) judge separates engine invariants from model behavior rates, and an aigent CLI runs or checks a directory with exit codes that say what kind of trouble a run had.

cases.head: b0230da
cases.target: runScenario refuses a secret or model key shorter than 8 characters as a scenario problem, because the scrub rewrites every occurrence of a raw secret, JSON keys included, and a 1-character key broke the result directory after model calls were spent.
